title: This toaster oven does it all!
text: This toaster oven does it all!. Really nice toaster oven. I had never heard of this brand before and since it had an air fryer option I was anxious to try it. Great size, enough room for a small chicken or pizza. Well made, silent and clear and large led display. I did have some confusion doing the original set up (clock for example) but once I read the manual, I had no problems. The air fryer works great and I used it the second day I had it with some chicken I was making. Chicken came out crispy and there was no mess. Quick and easy. This would make a great housewarming/bridal shower gift for someone or just as an option to replace an older unit you already own. Highly recommend!
